description: This Java source file defines the 'PhotoFragment' class, an Android Fragment responsible for displaying an image loaded from a URL. It manages the image view, handles user interactions such as clicks to zoom the image, and manages the lifecycle events of the fragment including saving state and cleaning up references.

classes.name: PhotoFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that displays an image loaded from a URL. Handles lifecycle events, user interactions, and state management.

methods.name: loadPhoto
methods.description: Converts the stored URL string to a URL object and attempts to download and set the image in the PhotoView. Handles malformed URL exceptions.

methods.name: getURLString
methods.description: Returns the stored URL string of the photo.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the image; sends a broadcast intent to zoom the image.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the fragment is created; currently just calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes views, sets click listeners, restores URL from saved state, and loads the photo if URL is available.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references to prevent memory leaks when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the fragment is detached from its activity.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current photo URL into the bundle to restore later.

methods.name: setPhoto
methods.description: Sets the URL string for the photo to be displayed.
